objective: Correct the 132 bilingual offline Children's Bible Stories: real in-story speech and passages instead of artificial classroom Q&A in the narrated manuscript. Preserve Sunday School teaching, audio, and all unrelated BUKLOD app functionality.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main commit 3b488fa704b804f05c5a289a7e0775daeabb2404 was inspected at code review. Staging and production OTA manifests, runtime identity and recent Ads/Nav telemetry are not verified here; this scope is DEV-only and must remain held until those independent checks pass.
chosenApproach: Isolate changes to the Bible story narrative assembly: suppress fabricated classroom asides without removing other biblical events, author expanded character-to-character paraphrases for the two reported screenshots and several additional biblical scenes, add 15 passage-grounded narrative elaborations and bilingual focused tests.
selectionRationale: Changing source narratives directly means the on-screen continuous manuscript and existing narration engine read the same corrected text, without altering TTS, shared runtime, Supabase, ad rendering or navigation.
alternativeApproaches: Leave the epilogue but rename it as a teaching question: rejected because the teacher conversation would still interrupt the requested Bible story and audio.
Automate fabricated dialogue for every biblical figure: rejected because fictional quotations misrepresent the Scripture.
Refactor the shared story reader and speech engine: rejected due unrelated runtime and performance regression risk.
preserveBehaviors: Keep all 132 bundled Scripture references and bilingual offline narratives, their three-act source data, moral/spiritual lessons, prayers, discussions, quizzes and user-scoped progress.
Keep the existing story text and audio playback using the same full lesson.narrative, without new native dependencies or Supabase migrations.
No changes to AdMob consent/creative lifecycle, first-view inventory, navigation, media rendering, payment/points integrity, authentication or production environment.
Avoid verbatim-source claims: character speech is clearly a child-friendly paraphrase where Scripture dialogue exists; when not recorded, do not fabricate a quotation.
No automatic staging/production OTA, native build, Firebase changes or Play Console release.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: The child Bible narration text is modified in the core app while all existing functionality is retained.
preservedBehaviors: Maintain offline and bilingual story reading, existing full-story speech playback and all unrelated ads/navigation functionality.

acceptanceChecks: All 132 stories and 264 bilingual narratives preserve source references and existing lesson/quiz data.
Neither the complete reading text nor the TTS narration includes an invented after-story teacher/classroom exchange or mid-story teacher/child lecture.
Expanded story examples incorporate biblically grounded speech where attested, without invented attributed dialogue.
No individual story shortened below existing 650-character regression length floor in either language.
Engineering Accountability governance, focused Node/Jest checks, Hermes/Expo runtime checks, and protected Ads/Nav gates pass before any release.
Staging verifies correct target runtime 1.3.2 and audio story, and production remains held pending full staging RC and exact OTA manifest verification.
